meta.name: epic-hypothesis
meta.description: Frame an epic as a testable hypothesis with target user, expected outcome, and validation method. Use when defining a major initiative before roadmap, discovery, or delivery planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将产品史诗转化为可测试的假设，明确用户与验证方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要启动大型产品项目，先通过假设明确方向与验证方法
copy.tagline_en: Frame epics as testable hypotheses with target users and validation methods
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define a major product initiative with a clear hypothesis before planning

howto.what: 当用户提出一个产品史诗（Epic）的想法时，Claude会将其转化为一个可测试的假设，格式为“如果……那么……”，并建议轻量级实验和验证标准，帮助用户管理不确定性。
howto.when: 当用户需要定义一项重大计划，尤其是在制定路线图、发现和交付计划之前，或希望将史诗作为假设验证时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个新功能写成可测试的假设。
say.note: Claude将输出完整的假设、实验和验证指标。

say.text: 针对提升用户留存，写一个if/then假设。
say.note: Claude会填充用户角色、预期结果和验证方法。

say.text: 给出一个包含实验的史诗验证计划。
say.note: Claude会设计快速实验并定义成功标准。

howto.what_en: When the user proposes an epic idea, Claude transforms it into a testable hypothesis using an if/then structure, suggesting lightweight experiments and validation criteria to manage uncertainty.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user needs to define a major initiative, especially before roadmap, discovery, or delivery planning, or when they want to treat the epic as a hypothesis.

say_en.text: Turn this new feature into a testable hypothesis.
say_en.note: Claude outputs full hypothesis, experiments, and metrics.

say_en.text: Write an if/then hypothesis for improving user retention.
say_en.note: Claude fills in persona, outcome, and validation.

say_en.text: Give me an epic validation plan with experiments.
say_en.note: Claude designs quick experiments and success criteria.
